title: 111 and 222 synchronicities during the reunion trip

tellings.quote: He landed at 111. And Omar, who's coming from Yes Theory, he is taking off at 111.

plain: During a 2026 trip in Texas that reunited Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens fifty years earlier, the numbers 111 and 222 kept turning up: one traveller landed at 1:11, and a man named Omar, from the YouTube channel Yes Theory, took off at 1:11. Michels tells this himself, from the trip, as a string of meaningful coincidences. He presents them as a sign that the reunion felt somehow guided.
